claims: U.S. stock markets (NYSE and Nasdaq) are closed on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.

Markets will reopen for regular trading hours on Monday, April 6, 2026.
Most major banks are generally open on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.
Good Friday is not a federal reserve holiday.
USPS is open and delivering mail on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.
Many international markets including the London Stock Exchange are closed on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.
Good Friday is not a federal holiday.
The stock market has a long tradition of closing on Good Friday.
